definition_or_measurement: Subsidy wedge on high-skilled R&D labour cost in B3
project_use: Potential macro input for wage-subsidy measures
notes: Do not use as total public R&D or PRIN proxy

definition_or_measurement: Tax credit or depreciation allowance affecting private R&D investment cost
project_use: Potential macro input for tax incentive measures
notes: Keep tax expenditure separate from eligible R&D and induced R&D

definition_or_measurement: RTDI programme support mapped to reductions in fixed and intangible capital costs in QUEST Cohesion 2009
notes: Underlying RTDI category broader than Frascati R&D

definition_or_measurement: Grants and operating funding to research performers by year and programme
project_use: PRIN and MUR public research pilots
notes: Not B3 s_RD; classify performer separately from funder

definition_or_measurement: Frascati eligible R&D expenditure actually performed in Italy by year and performer sector
notes: Separate source of funds and R&D type

definition_or_measurement: Incremental private R&D relative to explicit counterfactual
notes: No universal coefficient; keep gross R&D separate

definition_or_measurement: High-skilled research labour or R&D personnel FTE
notes: Not itself a policy input

definition_or_measurement: Accumulated domestic knowledge stock
notes: Requires model-specific construction and depreciation assumptions

definition_or_measurement: Foreign knowledge stock weighted by spillover exposure
notes: Requires international spillover weights

definition_or_measurement: Patent applications or grants attributable to resident inventors/performers
notes: Not a substitute for Frascati R&D expenditure

definition_or_measurement: Productive public capital stock from infrastructure investment
notes: Capital investment not automatically R&D expenditure

definition_or_measurement: Skill-specific human capital efficiency or research skill supply
notes: Do not classify all doctoral/training costs as R&D

definition_or_measurement: R&D production efficiency and domestic/foreign knowledge/researcher elasticities
notes: Do not import EU calibration as Italy-specific facts

definition_or_measurement: Observed firm R&D resources including researcher pay lab equipment materials and supplies
project_use: Microdata layer for behavioural response and validation
notes: Keep distinct from latent unobservable research effort and firm research productivity

definition_or_measurement: Unobservable organisational and researcher effort that complements measured R&D investment
notes: Do not treat as an extractable fiscal or accounting series

definition_or_measurement: Heterogeneous firm-specific efficiency in converting R&D investment and effort into innovation
notes: Not directly observed by government; firm heterogeneity matters for policy targeting

definition_or_measurement: Annual firm R&D expenditure and R&D intensity from administrative or survey data
notes: Check definition consistency and Frascati coverage across datasets

definition_or_measurement: Constructed marginal user cost of R&D reflecting tax credits and allowances
notes: Prefer price wedge to a simple tax-credit dummy where data permit

definition_or_measurement: Grant receipt indicator and grant amount at firm-year level
notes: Grant selection is endogenous and requires firm/application controls

definition_or_measurement: Scientists engineers and R&D personnel employment or FTE by firm-year
project_use: Mechanism validation and wage subsidy mapping
notes: Research labour is a component of R&D inputs and potentially adjustment-cost channel

definition_or_measurement: Regional or sectoral exposure to university research spending and research department characteristics
notes: Not direct firm R&D funding and not a substitute for knowledge spillover modelling

definition_or_measurement: Firm participation in formal R&D cooperation or joint research programme
notes: Keep separate from direct grants and from R&D expenditure amounts

definition_or_measurement: Firm size class industry and high-tech/manufacturing classification
notes: Use stable firm identifiers and version sector classifications
